D-145 recorded no platform-tcb leftover-join artifact. Its live heading is 'D-145 — Record gate-harness-naming.v6 as D-086 successor' and its Subject line pins docs/coop/artifacts/gate-harness-naming.v6.json b74e30092cf1f5aad55434d2f12465fa31111923c1b2c0c5ddc8a78445b5ffba — a different artifact in a different lineage. The subject therefore places the same artifact at D-185 in two fields and at D-145 in a third. Frozen leftover-join.v9 of platform-tcb, Dual ACCEPT 0/0, read 'Naming parent of G22 is naming v6 (D-145), not leftover-join.v8.' — where the bare token was correctly stemmed by the head noun 'naming' and the sentence's whole point was a contrast BETWEEN lineages.
